title: Star wiring to two loads
description: A 300x200x60mm enclosure holds psu (60x40x30mm), load_a (40x40x20mm), load_b (40x40x20mm) and fan (40x40x20mm). The fan must be at least 30mm clear of load_a. The psu outputs 12V on 'psu_out' ('V1 psu_out 0 DC 12', required exactly). Two wires leave the psu: psu -> load_a (psu_out -> la_in) and psu -> load_b (psu_out -> lb_in). Loads are fixed and must appear exactly: 'Rla la_in 0 8' and 'Rlb lb_in 0 20'. Constraints: V(la_in) >= 11.5V and V(lb_in) >= 11.6V. Return {"placements": [...min-corner [x,y,z] per component...], "netlist": "..."}. Wire resistance is 0.003 ohm per mm of Manhattan (axis-aligned) distance between component centers; the grader computes it from your placements and inserts it between the named nodes itself. Do NOT connect those node pairs directly in your netlist.
